offering_description.value: Powerfleet sells fleet and asset management software and connected devices to commercial fleet operators, logistics companies, industrial businesses, and public agencies. Its cloud platform combines data from vehicles, cameras, equipment, and third-party systems to help customers track assets, improve safety, and manage utilization.

primary_products.value: Fleet management software; vehicle telematics devices; in-cab video systems; trailer and asset trackers; forklift monitoring and access-control systems

primary_services.value: Device installation; fleet system implementation; data integration

customer_segment.value: B2B: Commercial fleet operators, trucking and logistics companies, manufacturers, and warehouse operators; B2G: Government agencies and public-sector fleet operators

end_markets.value: Transportation and logistics; commercial field services; warehousing and distribution; manufacturing; public-sector fleet operations

revenue_model.value: subscription: Recurring access to fleet software, device connectivity, and telematics data; product sales: Vehicle telematics devices, cameras, asset trackers, and industrial equipment monitors; service fees: Device installation, system implementation, and integration

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Combines vehicle, camera, and equipment data into fleet management tools for fleet and facility operators; brand owner: Designs connected devices made by contract manufacturers and sells them to fleet and facility operators; service provider: Installs devices and integrates customer systems for fleet and facility operators
value_chain_position.category: software / platform; brand owner; service provider

geography_served.value: global: North America, Latin America, Europe, Africa, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Vehicle telematics, video safety, trailer and asset tracking, and industrial fleet monitoring

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales teams serving fleet, logistics, and industrial accounts; partners / resellers: Wireless carriers and telematics resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Driver and location data privacy under GDPR and similar laws, plus FMCSA rules for electronic logging devices

notes: The mix of separately billed and bundled implementation services is uncertain.
